name: backend-delivery-agent-kit
description: Bộ chuẩn backend delivery tiếng Việt cho Node (NestJS/Express): plan bám SRS, quyết định API contract và thay đổi DB, migration có rollback, input sync, review, test evidence, PR readiness.

scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:kit
scripts.eval:pilot: npm run build && node evals/run.mjs pilot
scripts.eval:smoke: npm run build && node evals/run.mjs smoke
scripts.eval:gate: npm run build && node evals/run.mjs gate
scripts.eval:full: npm run build && node evals/run.mjs full
